newsitem.title: USA: Centocor files supplements for ReoPro use.
newsitem.headline: Centocor files supplements for ReoPro use.

text.p: Centocor Inc said on Tuesday it filed two supplements to its product license application for ReoPro, used to reduce ischemic complications in high risk angioplasty patients.

Centecor is filing with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to expand ReoPro's use in patients undergoing angioplasty, and for use in stabilizing patients with unstable angina who were not responding to conventional therapy.
